# Jason Walls

> I'm an electrician in IBEW Local 369 in Louisville, Kentucky, and I build software with Claude Code and a crew of AI agents. I have two apps on the App Store and a web product that takes payments. I build websites, iOS apps, internal tools and AI workflows for trades, local businesses and founders, and I work remotely across the US.

## Prices
Every job starts with a written scope and a fixed quote, and the quote is the price. Every price below is proposed and not yet approved.
- Launch Site: $3,500, 1 week. Up to five pages, a booking or quote form, analytics, on your own domain. (proposed · awaiting approval)
- Your Business on Claude: $4,500, 2 weeks. One to three AI workflows for your paperwork, installed where your crew already works, with training. (proposed · awaiting approval)
- MVP Web App or Internal Tool: from $12,000, 3 weeks, scoped first. Login, database, payments, one AI feature if it earns its place, and a preview link every week. (proposed · awaiting approval)
- iOS App to the App Store: from $10,000, 4 weeks, scoped first. Purchases, privacy page, screenshots and the App Store submission handled. (proposed · awaiting approval)
- Care Plan: $400 a month, up to 3 hours of changes, cancel anytime. (proposed · awaiting approval)
- Extra Day: $1,200 a day, for clients and former clients. (proposed · awaiting approval)

Payment is 50% to start and 50% at launch. On the MVP and iOS packages it is 40% to start, 30% at the mid-build preview and 30% at launch.

## What I have built
- [ChargeRight on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chargeright/id6755695416): free, version 4.0.1. A homeowner finds out whether the panel has room for an EV charger before paying for an upgrade. I wrote the NEC Article 220 load calculation engine it runs on. The web version is at [evchargeright.com](https://evchargeright.com).
- [BendRight on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bendright/id6779847124): $6.99, version 1.1. Offsets, saddles and kicks for conduit bending, with an AR measure and no account.
- [ZombieWells](https://zombiewells.com): a public site about abandoned, leaking oil wells in the Permian Basin, built with attorney Sarah Stogner.
- [Claude Code mods](https://github.com/LeeHigma0201/claude-code-mods): the mods I published.

## How a job runs
A free 20-minute call, then a written brief, then a fixed quote. On MVP and iOS jobs you get a preview every week, a link for web or a TestFlight build for iOS. Everything launches on accounts in your name, and you own the code, the domain and the data. An independent verifier checks the work before it ships.
